data.one_liner: Renders static HTML and CSS as Flutter widget trees.
data.what_it_does: The package parses HTML strings and CSS styles, converting them into native Flutter widgets. It supports many tags out of the box and allows custom extensions for unknown tags.
use_when: You need to display rich text content from HTML sources in a Flutter app
You want to apply CSS‑like styling without writing custom widget code
You need quick rendering of static HTML without a full webview
avoid_when: You need full web page features like forms, navigation, or dynamic scripts
strengths: Supports over a hundred HTML tags and many CSS properties
Customizable via extensions and style maps
weaknesses: Does not execute JavaScript or handle dynamic web content
Large HTML may impact performance compared to native widgets
Limited to static rendering; complex layouts may need workarounds
